stages.S03: Type the number shown on the plate in its written order. If you can verify a correct partial entry, continue with the next key.
stages.S04: Compare the recent successful typewriter key presses with the number plate. If they form its complete entry, inspect that printed group separately from earlier test output and use only its observed result with unlock; otherwise continue or correct the entry.
stages.S05: Use only the observed output group produced by the complete number-plate entry with unlock at the door.

stages.S01: Open the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles and take the apparently blank white sheet. If needed, read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window for the light rule.
stages.S02: Use the sheet on the table lamp and inspect the writing revealed on the paper.
stages.S03: Read the revealed writing on the sheet beside the desk lamp.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window about information appearing in darkness.
stages.S02: If the room is lit, press its light switch once. In the dark room, turn to inspect the walls for glowing writing.
stages.S03: Use the information visible in the dark state. Repeatedly turning the light back on hides the clue again.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window, then inspect the floor for the footprints it mentions.
stages.S02: Move onto the footprint position and face the fragmented pattern.
stages.S03: Read the complete pattern formed from that viewpoint.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window if needed, then open the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles and take the UV flashlight if you are not holding it.
stages.S02: Open the wardrobe door or doors that block your view of the inner back panel, specifying the corresponding part, 1 or 2. Adjust your view until that panel is exposed.
stages.S03: With the ultraviolet flashlight held, use it at a point on the exposed inner back panel of the wardrobe. Inspect the UV-lit photo returned by that use.
stages.S04: Inspect the writing in the UV-lit photo returned by the flashlight use. If that photo is unavailable or unclear, shine at the exposed inner panel again.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window. The gaming controller is the device used to operate the screen.
stages.S02: Take the controller from the desk farther from the window and the battery from the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles, if needed.
stages.S03: Use the battery on the gaming controller, or the controller on the battery, to supply it with power.
stages.S04: If the powered controller is still on the office desk farthest from the window, take it first. Then use the powered controller on the television and inspect the screen it turns on.
stages.S05: Inspect the information on the television screen that is now on. If it is outside your current view, turn or move to see the screen.
stages.S06: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect the black start square, each target square, and all thick barriers.
stages.S03: Find the shortest legal orthogonal route to each requested target independently, then use the target order on the note.
stages.S04: Trace every route from its marked start along the open grid connections.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: View the sculpture square-on from one side, then from the other required side.
stages.S03: Recognise a complete number from each side and apply the smaller/larger ordering stated on the note.
stages.S04: Changing the camera by only a small angle may still show the same face. Obtain a genuinely different side view.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and inspect the bottom of the empty glass tank.
stages.S02: Take the water container and use its water on the glass tank.
stages.S03: Inspect the bottom of the filled glass tank through the water. Adjust your view if the bottom is still out of sight.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect every numbered node and the explicit lines connecting it to the lamp positions.
stages.S03: Find a lamp set that satisfies every linked-node count and the total number of lit lamps required on the note.
stages.S04: Only drawn connections count. Recheck the same candidate against all numbered nodes.
stages.S05: Use the entry you derive from the room clues by pressing this existing keypad one key at a time. A rejected attempt starts again on the cleared display.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window for the required total voltage, and inspect the voltage label on every switch.
stages.S02: While the door is still locked, choose a subset of the labelled voltages that totals the note's target exactly, and press the switches to set that subset. Stop adjusting after the door is released.
stages.S03: Add the labelled voltages of the switches currently on and adjust that set to reach the total required by the desk sheet. Each press toggles one switch.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect both wing halves on every card and the two specified endpoint colours.
stages.S03: Build a continuous chain whose touching halves match, respecting the required number of cards, then read the chain's labels.
stages.S04: Check both the next colour match and whether the route can still reach the required endpoint.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window for the wall-switch order.
stages.S02: Identify the next switch from its location description on the card.
stages.S03: A wrong switch resets the sequence. Start again from the first location on the card.

stages.S01: Read the exit clue on the office desk farthest from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect the top drawer of the office light-wood drawer cabinet with silver handles for the key and take it. Solving the numerical lock alone is insufficient.
stages.S03: Use unlock on the exit door with the information from the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S04: If you already hold the recovered key and the key lock is still closed, use that key on the door. Separately, if the small light beside the locks is off, press the room's wall switch.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: If the spotlights are off, press their wall switch once. With the spotlights on, inspect the number illuminated by each beam.
stages.S03: Read only the illuminated labels, in the left-to-right spotlight order on the note.
stages.S04: Nearby unlit numbers are distractors. Align each beam with the surface it actually hits.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Read all the example equations and the expression or symbol order beside the door.
stages.S03: Solve the examples consistently for each shape's value before evaluating the door clue.
stages.S04: A shape must have the same value in every example. Preserve the operation signs and any grouped expression.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect the top and bottom colours of each numbered model and the reference card.
stages.S03: Match each two-colour pattern to a real model using top-versus-bottom orientation, then use the card's model order.
stages.S04: A reversed top/bottom pair is a different pattern.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect each group of small frames and its adjacent label, then compare the reference card.
stages.S03: Match each pictured frame-group arrangement to the real wall group and read its label in the card's order.
stages.S04: Compare the internal arrangement of each group.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on top of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles, then inspect the corresponding rows on the two letter boards above the desk.
stages.S02: For each word-card letter, find its column in the stated row of the left board and read the mirrored column in the same row of the right board.
stages.S03: Mirror the column position within the row.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Open the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles in the bathroom and inspect the yellow sticky note inside.
stages.S02: Take the backwards-written yellow sticky note from the bathroom light-wood cabinet's top drawer if needed, use it on the bathroom mirror, then read the legible writing.
stages.S03: Use the legible exit information obtained from the yellow sticky note taken from the bathroom light-wood cabinet's top drawer to unlock the bathroom exit.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window about the wardrobe top and take the stool that can raise your viewpoint.
stages.S02: If you are holding the stool, use it on the wardrobe to place it and raise your viewpoint. If it is already placed there, use the stool to step back onto it, then aim at the writing on top.
stages.S03: Face the wardrobe top from the raised viewpoint and inspect the writing there.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window if needed, then open the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles and take the camera if you are not holding it.
stages.S02: Use the camera to examine the sign outside the window while facing it.
stages.S03: Transcribe the observed sign.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and take the board eraser.
stages.S02: Use the eraser on the whiteboard to remove the erasable writing, then inspect what remains.
stages.S03: Adjust your view to inspect the permanent marks that remain on the board, then use those observed marks at the exit.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and take the box on the reddish-brown cabinet.
stages.S02: Use the box you took from the reddish-brown cabinet on the X-ray device and inspect the returned picture.
stages.S03: Use the information actually visible inside the scan.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and take the pencil. The missing top page may have left impressions underneath.
stages.S02: Use the pencil on the remaining notepad sheet to reveal the indentations.
stages.S03: Look closely at the marks visible on the rubbed sheet, then use the observed information at the exit.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect all completed example rows and the candidate tiles for each blank.
stages.S03: Compare which marks are retained or removed when the example tiles combine, infer one consistent rule, then apply it to the blanks.
stages.S04: Test the same rule against every completed row before choosing a candidate.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and inspect the fingerprint reference cards on the wall above that desk.
stages.S02: Take the fingerprint-powder bottle from the top drawer of the reddish-brown cabinet if needed, then use it on the touched area of the window.
stages.S03: Compare the revealed print with the identity references and use the identifier of the matching person.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Take the coin and inspect the small chart that marks the body locations to scratch.
stages.S02: Scratch an intact marked body-location panel with the coin.
stages.S03: Inspect the numbers revealed at the chart's marked body locations and use the chart's numbered order at the exit.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window so you know which objects matter and what order the readings require.
stages.S02: Take the next required object, place the object on the scale, and read its kg value.
stages.S03: Record the visible reading, then take the object off the scale before placing another object on it.
stages.S04: Review the scale images for every required object. If a reading is missing and that object is still on the scale, inspect its display.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect each coloured pile from more than one side, keeping a separate tally for each colour.
stages.S03: Account for blocks hidden behind or supporting visible blocks, then use the colour order specified on the note.
stages.S04: Revisit the pile whose tally is uncertain.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Inspect the reference layout on the wall and compare its marked tiles with the floor grid. You may use the layout directly.
stages.S02: Take a plant that is still missing from, or misplaced in, the reference arrangement.
stages.S03: If a plant is still in your hand, use it on a missing position marked in the reference. After a placement, inspect the whole arrangement and its actual mechanism feedback before repeating any action.
stages.S04: Take a plant off a tile that should be empty in the reference, then place it on a missing marked tile. The plants are interchangeable.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect the top and every shelf of both bookcases, taking comparable views.
stages.S03: Compare matching levels and count differences in the level order specified by the note.
stages.S04: Compare like-for-like shelf levels and count each actual difference once.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Find and take the metal detector. The key is inside a storage ottoman.
stages.S02: Use the detector on reachable ottomans one at a time and pay attention to which actual ottoman produces a beep.
stages.S03: Open the same ottoman that beeped.
stages.S04: Look inside the opened ottoman and take the visible key yourself.
stages.S05: Use the recovered exit key on the final door lock, then check the door itself. A released key still has to be applied.

stages.S01: Inspect the wall photograph and compare it with the current orientations of the toys on the desk by the window.
stages.S02: Press a toy whose orientation differs from the photograph and inspect the next image. Each press rotates that toy.
stages.S03: After pressing a toy, inspect the current orientations and the actual mechanism feedback before pressing again. Leave toys that already match the photograph alone.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and match each numbered colour card to the bowl with the same number.
stages.S02: Choose an empty bowl by its same-number target card. Identify a required primary paint from its liquid or label, take that paint bucket if needed, and use it on the bowl.
stages.S03: Compare the bowl with its same-number colour card. If its current primary colour belongs in the required mix, take and add the missing primary; otherwise use the rag to empty this bowl.
stages.S04: Use the rag to empty the numbered bowl containing an unwanted primary colour, then mix the required colours again.
stages.S05: Compare each bowl with its same-number colour card. Inspect the latest liquid colour and mechanism feedback; if a bowl contains an unwanted colour, use the rag to empty it before mixing again.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window, then locate the red-star floor tile and the direction of the window.
stages.S02: Use the red-star tile and the window direction to trace the route across the visible grid. Count tile boundaries.
stages.S03: If you are not holding the scraper, open the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles and take it. Use the scraper on the destination tile inferred from the route and floor grid.
stages.S04: Take the exposed key from the opened floor tile.
stages.S05: Use the recovered exit key on the final door lock, then check the door itself. A released key still has to be applied.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and inspect the floor plate before treating it as an ordinary button.
stages.S02: Take a substantial object from the room and bring it to the empty pressure plate.
stages.S03: Use the held object on the empty pressure plate, then inspect the plate and check the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles.
stages.S04: Take the current object off the plate before trying a heavier object. The plate holds only one object at a time.
stages.S05: Inspect part 1 of the office light-wood drawer cabinet with silver handles released by the pressure plate. Open that compartment if it is closed and take the key inside.
stages.S06: Use the recovered exit key on the final door lock, then check the door itself. A released key still has to be applied.

stages.S01: Inspect the inlet, outlet, and the open ports of the pipe tiles before pressing tiles at random.
stages.S02: Trace a route from IN and rotate the tile at the first disconnected join so its opening connects to the next tile.
stages.S03: Check every connection along the inlet-to-outlet pipe route.
stages.S04: Any connected IN-to-OUT route is valid. Stop rotating the solved route and check the released exit.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and compare the coloured mats with the animal toys.
stages.S02: Use the fixed-colour, next-to, and endpoint restrictions together to work out a consistent seating arrangement.
stages.S03: Take the toy you want to place, then use it on the chosen mat. If that mat is occupied, take the toy off it before placing another one.
stages.S04: Recheck neighbour relationships and endpoint restrictions across the whole row.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Read the complete office-rules sheet, then inspect the room for violations of those rules.
stages.S03: Match violations in the room's original arrangement to their rule numbers, then use the order requested by the rules sheet. Compare earlier views to separate the initial arrangement from changes you made.
stages.S04: Compare your earlier room views with the rules sheet. A drawer you opened while searching is a change you caused.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Inspect the complete light panel and note which lights are currently on and off.
stages.S02: One press toggles its own light and its orthogonal neighbours. Compare the before and after images to account for all affected lights.
stages.S03: While the door is still locked, plan presses from the panel's current on/off state. Pressing the same button twice cancels its effect.
stages.S04: Check all rows of the panel. The target is the complete all-on state.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and inspect the board's rows, columns, and diagonals.
stages.S02: Take an available toy figure and use it on an empty board square. Place all four so that no pair shares a row, column, or diagonal; any arrangement satisfying these conditions works.
stages.S03: Take a conflicting figure off the board, then use it on another empty square that avoids row, column and diagonal conflicts.
stages.S04: Check every pair for diagonal conflicts as well as shared rows and columns.

stages.S01: Read the yellow sticky note in the second drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles.
stages.S02: Read the dark-covered book from the reddish-brown cabinet's top drawer. If it is locked, unlock it using the yellow sticky note from the second drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles.
stages.S03: Read the white sheet in the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles for the other part of the counting rule.
stages.S04: Count each room-object category named by the book and the white sheet, counting each physical object once across different views.
stages.S05: Use the first-part categories from the dark-covered book in the reddish-brown cabinet, followed by the last-part categories from the white sheet in the light-wood cabinet with silver handles.
stages.S06: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on top of the laundry-room drawer cabinet.
stages.S02: Find the dark-covered book in the second drawer of the laundry room drawer cabinet, unlock the book using the cabinet-top note, and read the book.
stages.S03: Use the drawer information from the dark-covered book in the laundry cabinet's second drawer to unlock part 4 of that cabinet. Open part 4 and inspect inside.
stages.S04: Take the key from the fourth drawer of the laundry room drawer cabinet and use the key at the outside exit.
stages.S05: Use the recovered exit key on the final door lock, then check the door itself. A released key still has to be applied.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window for the symbol sequence to decode.
stages.S02: Read the symbol notes on both office desks, on the reddish-brown cabinet, and in the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles.
stages.S03: Translate the symbol clue using the collected references. The same repeated symbol must always use the same value.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window for the colour order, keeping the colour and value of each numerical note already found.
stages.S02: Read the notes in the top drawers of the reddish-brown cabinet and the light-wood cabinet with silver handles, plus those on the light-wood cabinet top and the desk below the window. Keep each value with its paper colour.
stages.S03: Associate each observed value with its note's colour and use the colour order on the card.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window if needed, then take the loose mirror lying on that desk.
stages.S02: Compare the laser's approach direction with the sensor's position and use the mirror on a stand that can reflect toward the sensor.
stages.S03: Take the mirror back from its current stand before using it on another stand. Compare the reflected beam with the sensor.
stages.S04: The laser releases the top drawer of the office light-wood drawer cabinet with silver handles. Open that released drawer with part 1 and take the key inside.
stages.S05: Use the recovered exit key on the final door lock, then check the door itself. A released key still has to be applied.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Read the menu and inspect all food and drink objects in the room. Count each physical object once across different views.
stages.S03: Add the menu prices for the food and drink objects actually present. Write the total with two decimal places, keeping any trailing zero, then remove the decimal point as the note instructs.
stages.S04: Match each room food object to its menu price and add one price for every object present.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Read the white sheet on the light-wood cabinet with silver handles and locate the symbols listed on the sheet.
stages.S03: Describe each symbol's actual relative position, match that description to the location card, then keep the requested symbol order.
stages.S04: Use the whole spatial relation, including above/below and beside/behind.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window, take the ruler, and compare the labelled plan with the taped shape on the floor.
stages.S02: Rotate the plan mentally to match the floor shape and choose the next required labelled edge.
stages.S03: Use the ruler on a required taped edge and inspect the scale in the photo returned by that measurement. Keep its plan label with the reading in the requested unit.
stages.S04: Use the labelled-edge order from the note.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the yellow sticky note in the top drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles.
stages.S02: Read each number sheet on the desks and cabinets, then return to the doorway facing into the room.
stages.S03: Order the observed sheets by their positions from that fixed doorway view.
stages.S04: Stand at the doorway and order the sheets from left to right in that view.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and the sticky note in the top drawer of the reddish-brown cabinet.
stages.S02: Use the window note to establish the room's compass directions and inspect every wall. Keep the rule note's required picture-count order separate.
stages.S03: Count pictures on each wall separately and use the compass-direction order specified by the rule sheet.
stages.S04: If you turned, your current left/right changed but north/east did not. Recheck the wall-to-direction mapping.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect each bust's facing direction and the number lying along its gaze.
stages.S03: Associate one actual gaze target with each bust, then apply the size ordering required by the note.
stages.S04: Follow each bust's gaze to its actual number and keep the bust-size order from the desk sheet.
stages.S05: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the sticky note beside each of the three numbered boxes on the floor.
stages.S02: Evaluate each candidate against the condition that only one statement is true. Choose only a box consistent with all statements.
stages.S03: Inspect the opened box and take the useful item inside before approaching the exit.
stages.S04: Use the recovered exit key on the final door lock, then check the door itself. A released key still has to be applied.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window and identify both jugs, the water source, the emptying target, and the ice bucket.
stages.S02: Fill the tall jug from the water bucket before beginning the transfer.
stages.S03: Pour from the tall jug into the short jug until the short jug is full. Keep the water remaining in the tall jug.
stages.S04: Empty the short jug into the plant pot, keeping the water in the tall jug.
stages.S05: Pour the remaining water from the tall jug into the now-empty short jug.
stages.S06: Refill the tall jug from the water source while keeping the water already in the short jug.
stages.S07: Pour from the full tall jug into the partially filled short jug until the short jug is full. Retain the water left in the tall jug.
stages.S08: Use the tall jug on the ice bucket now.
stages.S09: Use transfers that fill the receiving jug or empty the pouring jug. Keep track of each container's remaining space.
stages.S10: Use the jug holding the required amount on the ice bucket. Stop manipulating other containers once the correct reserve has been isolated.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect every copy of the motto and identify the one upside-down letter in each copy.
stages.S03: Correct the orientation of each exceptional letter and use the location order given on the note.
stages.S04: Use the clue order and decode each upside-down letter individually.
stages.S05: Use the entry you derive from the room clues by pressing this existing keypad one key at a time. A rejected attempt starts again on the cleared display.

stages.S01: Read the sticky notes on top of the reddish-brown cabinet, the light-wood cabinet with silver handles, and the desk below the window.
stages.S02: Express the later positions in terms of the first position, then enforce every stated relation and digit restriction together.
stages.S03: Recheck that each derived value is a permitted digit and that the same first-position choice satisfies every note.
stages.S04: Use unlock on the final door with the information you derive from the collected clues.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Inspect the doll house's lit windows on every floor and keep the top-to-bottom floor order given by the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S03: Use your observed lit-window counts to unlock the second drawer of the office light-wood drawer cabinet with silver handles, then open it and inspect its contents.
stages.S04: In the second drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles, read the small card and take the blank white sheet beside the card.
stages.S05: Use the blank paper on the typewriter before pressing keys.
stages.S06: Inspect the number written on the red box and type that observed input on the machine.
stages.S07: Use the printed result to unlock and open the red metal box on the floor, then read the back of the picture card inside.
stages.S08: Take an animal toy that still needs to be placed.
stages.S09: Use the photograph to associate the animal with its owner and place it on that owner's named mat. Remove a wrong occupant first if needed.
stages.S10: The family arrangement has released the exit. Check the door.

stages.S01: Read the white sheet on the desk farther from the window.
stages.S02: Read the wall clock in afternoon HHMM form for the lock on the second drawer of the light-wood cabinet with silver handles.
